newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar narrowly mixed, big role for switches.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar narrowly mixed, big role for switches.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was narrowly mixed and a high proportion of switch trades inflated volume, traders said.
By 1525 GMT front month August was 20 cents lower at $320.00. August dominated volume with 1,405 of a total 2,921 lots done so far.
Although New York was the main influence on the market in afternoon trade, London failed to emulate New York's moves, staying in a tight range, one trader said.
"It was fairly active in the morning, mainly on spreads, and then there was a bit of hedging against the EU tender," he said.
The EU sold 64,275 tonnes of white sugar at rebate 42.874 ECUs.

A report by brokers GNI held out little hope of more activity. "After eight months of sideways activity, there appears to be no major reason to expect a substantial move in the next few months," GNI said in its Commodity Perspective report.
